intro: Football is by far Libya's most popular sport.

chapters.title: Football
text: Libya hosted the 1982 Africa Cup of Nations and reached the final. In 2014 it won the African Nations Championship for home-based players.

chapters.title: Clubs
text: Al-Ittihad and Al-Ahli of Tripoli are big rivals.

keyTerms.meaning: The African Nations Championship for home-based players.

items.title: Libyan Premier League
items.subtitle: Football
items.text: Al-Ittihad have won the most titles.
